GetVer.text: The program's version as text: "v major.minor", plus a letter when the revision is not 0 (1 = a, 2 = b ...).

GetOsVer.text: Describes the operating system: on Windows "Microsoft Windows" and the release name that matches the build number (from the W_VER table); on Linux the values read from /etc/os-release (pretty name, version, and so on) with their quotation marks removed. Other systems give an empty string.

TfrmBase.FormActivate.text: OnActivate handler: shows the OK and Cancel buttons by default; forms that inherit from this one change that by calling SetButtons themselves.

TfrmBase.FormCreate.text: OnCreate handler of the base dialog; nothing to do here, inheriting forms add their own set-up.

TfrmBase.SetButtons.text: Shows only the chosen buttons (OK, Cancel, Apply) at the bottom of the dialog and slides the visible ones to the right so no gap is left.

params.Buttons: the set of buttons to show

TfrmAbout.FormCreate.text: OnCreate handler: fills in the copyright text, the application name with its target (x86 or x64), the version and the operating system description.

TfrmMain.pnlLeftClick.text: Click handler of the left panel; nothing to do.

TfrmMain.DoTheme.text: Menu handler: switches between the light and dark ribbon theme and changes the menu item's caption to offer the other one.

TfrmMain.RibbonTabRect.text: The rectangle of one ribbon tab in the painted tab strip: tabs sit side by side, each as wide as its caption plus padding, starting a little in from the left.
TfrmMain.RibbonTabRect.returns: the tab's rectangle, or an empty one if the index is out of range

TfrmMain.RibbonTabAt.text: Which painted ribbon tab is under a point.
TfrmMain.RibbonTabAt.returns: the page index, or -1 if the point is on no tab

TfrmMain.RibbonTabsPaint.text: Paints the ribbon tab strip: the header color as background, each page caption as a tab, the active tab highlighted and the one under the mouse in the hover color, all from the current theme.

TfrmMain.RibbonTabsMouseMove.text: Remembers which tab the mouse is over and repaints the strip when that changes.

TfrmMain.RibbonTabsMouseLeave.text: The mouse left the tab strip: no tab is hot any more.

TfrmMain.RibbonTabsMouseDown.text: A left click on a tab makes that ribbon page the active one.

TfrmMain.RibbonPageChange.text: The active ribbon page changed, so repaint the tab strip to highlight it.

TLibEntry.Destroy.text: Frees the library this entry holds.

TfrLibraryPanel.FilterChange.text: Event handler: the filter text changed, so rebuild the tree.

TfrLibraryPanel.TreeChange.text: Event handler: the selection in the tree changed, so show the preview of the selected symbol (nothing is shown for a library node). Ignored while the tree is being rebuilt.

TfrLibraryPanel.ListDblClick.text: Event handler: a double click on the tree or a click on the preview asks the owner to place the selected symbol. On a library node it does nothing, so the tree's own double-click opens or closes it.

TfrLibraryPanel.PreviewPaint.text: Draws the selected symbol, scaled to fit, in the preview area.

TfrLibraryPanel.SelectedRef.text: What the selected symbol node stands for.
TfrLibraryPanel.SelectedRef.returns: the symbol's library, set and record, or nil when a library node or nothing is selected

TfrLibraryPanel.SelectedEntry.text: The library the selected node belongs to, whether the node is the library itself or one of its symbols.
TfrLibraryPanel.SelectedEntry.returns: the library entry, or nil when nothing is selected

TfrLibraryPanel.FindEntry.text: Finds an open library by its file name (ignoring case on systems where that is how files are named).
TfrLibraryPanel.FindEntry.returns: its position in the list of open libraries, or -1

params.FileName: full path of the library file

TfrLibraryPanel.UpdateCaption.text: Sets the caption above the tree: none open, the name of the one open library, or how many are open.

TfrLibraryPanel.Rebuild.text: Rebuilds the tree from the open libraries: a node per library (with the number of symbols shown) and a child per symbol, keeping only the symbols whose name or description contains the filter text. While filtering, libraries without a match disappear and the others are opened; otherwise each library stays open or closed as it was. The selected symbol stays selected if it is still listed.

TfrLibraryPanel.BuildPreview.text: Builds the one-symbol design that the preview draws from the selected symbol, or clears the preview when no symbol is selected.

TfrLibraryPanel.TreeMouseDown.text: A right click selects the node under the pointer, so the pop-up menu acts on it.

TfrLibraryPanel.PopupClose.text: Pop-up menu handler: closes the library the selected node belongs to.

TfrLibraryPanel.PopupCloseAll.text: Pop-up menu handler: closes every library.

TfrLibraryPanel.Create.text: Creates the panel: the lists of open libraries and of symbol references, and the pop-up menu (Close library, Close all libraries) of the tree.

TfrLibraryPanel.Destroy.text: Drops the preview and the tree, then frees the references and the open libraries.

TfrLibraryPanel.OpenLibrary.text: Opens a symbol library and adds it to the tree, opened and selected. A library that is already open is read again instead of being listed twice. If the file cannot be read the error is raised and the tree is unchanged. The filter is cleared so the new library is visible.

TfrLibraryPanel.CloseLibrary.text: Closes one library and removes it from the tree.

params.Index: position in the list of open libraries (out of range is ignored)

TfrLibraryPanel.CloseAll.text: Closes every library and empties the tree.

TfrLibraryPanel.LibFileName.text: The file an open library was read from.

params.Index: position in the list of open libraries
position in the list of open libraries

TfrLibraryPanel.Lib.text: The library of the selected node, otherwise the first open library.
TfrLibraryPanel.Lib.returns: the library, or nil when none is open

TfrLibraryPanel.RecordNode.text: The node of the n-th symbol in tree order (across all libraries, whether or not its library is open).

TfrLibraryPanel.SelectRow.text: Selects the n-th symbol in tree order, opening its library, and shows its preview. An index out of range is ignored.

TfrLibraryPanel.PlaceSelected.text: Asks the owner to place the selected symbol (OnPlace); a library node or no selection does nothing.

TfrLibraryPanel.RowCount.text: How many symbols the tree lists (those matching the filter), across all libraries.

TfrLibraryPanel.RowText.text: The text of the n-th symbol in tree order: its name and description.
TfrLibraryPanel.RowText.returns: the text, or empty when out of range
